prompt: Which organizational Actions policies are real? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Org settings can allow-list by pattern or SHA, gate first-time contributors, and switch Actions off per repository — but the allow list accepts friendly refs, not SHAs only, and an enterprise policy is the ceiling an organization cannot exceed.

options.text: Restricting which actions may run, via an allow list
Allow lists may reference actions only by exact commit SHA
Requiring approval before workflows from new contributors run
Organization policy overrides an enterprise-level allow list
Disabling Actions for selected repositories in the organization
